items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: And so my entrance into the band you might say was to play Maxine's music.

ctx.x: Well, that I don't know. I don't know whether Pete was leaving or not. But I do know that Kirby was looking for someone to play Maxine's music, and all due respect to everybody, when they were recording Maxine they had to get an outside alto player to play the music. So I suppose when I happened on the scene that night, I suppose -- I suppose -- and I sat in, I suppose it was just what he was
looking for. And so my entrance into the band you might say was to play Maxine's music. And whatever happened after that was just, you know, frosting on the cake.
Uh-huh. So but you -- so you don't know why Pete Brown left.
